name: Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 on machinery
description: Replaces the Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC. Sets health/safety requirements for machinery design and construction, adding explicit cybersecurity obligations — safety-related control systems and software must resist both accidental faults and deliberate cyberattacks, with manufacturers required to provide security updates for up to 10 years.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by European Union (europa.eu) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within European Union (europa.eu).
